events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic album 'Imagine' on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. Its message still resonates today. What does this timeless anthem mean to you?

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Musician Sting, born Gordon Matthew Thomas Sumner, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy 75th Sting
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Sting! From The Police to his solo work, which of his tracks is your all-time favourite?

events.title: First iPod launched
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Remembering the iPod
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Twenty-five years ago, the first iPod dropped and changed how we listened to music forever. What was on your first iPod?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic film franchise's enduring legacy.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite 007 and which theme song gets you shaken, not stirred?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: On this day, we remember music icon John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Thinking of John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your most cherished Lennon track?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles gave us 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece! What's your go-to track from this iconic record?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the 35th anniversary of the passing of Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped, marking a pivotal moment in music history. Which track from the album always gets you?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the 46th anniversary of the tragic death of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon Remembrance
angles.copy: Forty-six years on, we remember John Lennon. His music and spirit live on. What's the John Lennon song that resonates most with you?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: On this day, we remember music visionary David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday.

angles.name: Bowie's 80th
angles.copy: Remembering David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday. A true innovator. Which of his many eras is your favourite?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday.

angles.name: The King's 92nd
angles.copy: Remembering Elvis Presley on what would have been his 92nd birthday. The King's legacy still reigns supreme. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Jimmy Page
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped rock 'n' roll. What's your favourite Led Zeppelin guitar moment?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Rock and pop icon Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rod Stewart
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the legendary Rod Stewart! His distinctive voice has given us so many hits. Which one is your all-time favourite?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Suggs
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the inimitable Suggs! The voice of Madness, bringing us joy for decades. What's your favourite nutty track?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' singer Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Paul Young
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the smooth-voiced Paul Young! So many great hits. Which one always takes you back?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music legend Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Dolly Parton
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true icon of music and philanthropy. What's your favourite Dolly song?
